External Communication

เปลี่ยนทิศทาง

Instruction to change the vessel’s current heading in order to avoid danger or comply with traffic management.

Definition

Instruction to change the vessel’s current heading in order to avoid danger or comply with traffic management.

Operational example

Bulk carrier Europa, this is VTS Zeebrugge: alter course ten degrees to port to avoid crossing traffic lane near buoy Kilo.
